title: Plasma cfDNA multi-omic biomarkers profiling for detection and stratification of gastric carcinoma.
authors: Song, Shiyi; Zhang, Xiuli; Cui, Pin; He, Weihuang; Zhou, Jiyuan; Wang, Shubing; Xiong, Yong; Xu, Shu; Lin, Xiaohui; Huang, Guozeng; Tan, Xiaohua; Xu, Qinglong; Liu, Yongling; Li, Qingqun; Yuan, Kehua; Feng, Mingji; Lai, Hanming; Yang, Hui; Zhang, Shaorong
one_liner_zh: 该文利用血浆cfDNA多组学特征和机器学习进行胃癌检测，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Despite being the third in death rate among all cancers globally, gastric carcinoma (GC) is far from being detected accurately and timely, which could benefit the prognosis. To achieve this, we performed whole-genome sequencing (WGS) to plasma cfDNA of 733 participants, including healthy individuals, patients with benign gastric diseases and GC patients. The multi-omic biomarkers in this study, including fragmentation profile, end motif and genome-wide Copy Number Variations (CNV) of plasma cfDNA, are recently developed means for cancer detection and monitoring. And these biomarkers were extracted from WGS data to build machine learning algorithm based classifiers, prediction models, to discriminate GC patients from healthy individuals, achieving extremely high precision of sensitivity at 94.87% and specificity at 99.35%. Therefore, these cfDNA multi-omic biomarkers may serve as means to detect GC accurately, affordably and timely.
abstract_zh: 尽管胃癌（GC）在全球所有癌症死亡率中排名第三，但其检测远未达到准确和及时，而这本可改善预后。为实现此目标，我们对733名参与者的血浆cfDNA进行了全基因组测序（WGS），包括健康个体、良性胃病患者和胃癌患者。本研究中采用的多组学标志物，包括血浆cfDNA的片段化谱、末端基序和全基因组拷贝数变异（CNV），是近期开发的用于癌症检测和监测的手段。这些标志物从WGS数据中提取，用于构建基于机器学习算法的分类器，即预测模型，以区分胃癌患者与健康个体，实现了极高的精确度，敏感性达94.87%，特异性达99.35%。因此，这些cfDNA多组学标志物可能作为准确、经济且及时检测胃癌的手段。
